candidates.desc: Clip0_100( Avg([ Offset(HGB exp081 params), Offset(ExtraTrees 500/leaf 2), Ridge pipeline unchanged ]) ) on the 567 scoring rows, the 11 features above, raw % target.
candidates.offset_base: base(X) = np.nanmean(X[:, [3, 4, 5]], axis=1), i.e. row-wise nanmean of sta_res_3K, sta_res_10K, sta_res_30K (each already a replicate mean per material per rate). Equal weight per AVAILABLE rate (materials with one rate use that rate). Coefficient fixed at 1. Computed from features inside the wrapper, so it is fold-safe and label-free. The base is NOT appended as a feature. If any row's base is NaN, stop BLOCKED (cannot happen on the 567 rows).
candidates.Offset(m): fit(X, y): m.fit(X, y - base(X)); predict(X): m.predict(X) + base(X). Applied to the HGB and the ET members only.

members.HGB: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=300, max_leaf_nodes=15, min_samples_leaf=10, random_state=0), NaN-native, fit on y - base
members.ET: ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=500, min_samples_leaf=2, random_state=0, n_jobs=-1), NaN-native (scikit-learn 1.7.1), fit on y - base
members.Ridge: make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy='median', add_indicator=True, keep_empty_features=True), StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=10.0)) fit on raw y (no offset), identical to exp117's Ridge

candidates.clip: Clip0_100: the final averaged prediction is np.clip(pred, 0.0, 100.0). Members are NOT clipped before averaging. The incumbent exp117 stays unclipped as recorded (critic: clipping exp117 gives 0.6505).
candidates.protocol: eval_protocol.repeated_group_kfold(Clip0_100(Avg(...)), X, y, groups) with data_cr()'s X, y, groups -> identical folds to exp117 (paired).

candidates.nan_handling: HGB NaN-native; ET NaN-native exactly as in exp117; Ridge median impute + missing indicators + StandardScaler exactly as in exp117 (with the extra rows, SimpleImputer automatically adds indicators for mcc_char_yield_pct and sta_res_10K as well, which are never NaN on the 567 rows but are NaN on 96 and 105 of the 136 extra rows; this follows from the recipe and is not a separate choice).

ET is kept NaN-native because that IS the exp117 recipe: exp117's ET already received NaN (density 62 rows, sta_res_3K 164, sta_res_30K 152) and scikit-learn 1.7.1 ExtraTreesRegressor routes NaN natively. adoption.rule_in_force: Fixed before any candidate is scored, from Arnav's D1 answer quoted under 'amendments'. D1 approved -> rule A. D1 explicitly declined -> rule B. D1 unanswered when D2 is approved -> BLOCKED: do not score anything until D1 is answered (consistent with adoption_gate_v2.json scope.if_D1_pending_or_declined). The executor never picks the rule itself.
adoption.family: All CR candidates scored against exp117 on these 567 rows before the CR adoption decision: this config's o1, o2, n1, plus B2's CR members (TabPFN p1, p2) if D3 is approved and they run in round 9 as planned -> K = 5 (K = 3 if B2 is not approved or not run in round 9). K is fixed by Arnav's D1/D3 answers and open question 3 before any CR score: K = 5 when D1 and D3 are both approved and Arnav has not moved B2's CR members to a later round; K = 3 otherwise (B2 is not run at all if D1 is declined, per round9_tabpfn_smearing.json). The CR adoption decision is made only after every family member has been scored. If any family member cannot be scored (e.g. B2 BLOCKED by a failed install), the CR adoption decision is parked with a blocker file until Arnav rules; the executor never decides with a smaller family.
adoption.selection (both rules): Among selectable members (o1, n1, and B2's selectable CR members if in the family), the one with the highest rkf_mean at full precision; exact ties -> first in order (this config's order, then B2's). Only that candidate is tested. If it fails, exp117 stays; no fallback to the second-best.
adoption.rule_A_if_D1_approved: experiments/configs/adoption_gate_v2.json exactly (G1 wins >= 8/10 strict; G2 repeat-0 ci_lo >= exp117's repeat-0 ci_lo as reproduced in step 1 of this run, i.e. ci_lo_full in experiments/runs/cr_round2_step1_exp117.json; G3 studentised max-T paired group-bootstrap lower bound of the repeat-mean gain > 0, B 2000, seed 0, draws identical to eval_protocol.bootstrap_ci, ddof 1, linear 0.95 quantile, over the whole family). If the approved text of adoption_gate_v2.json differs from this summary, the approved file governs.
adoption.rule_B_if_D1_declined: the current rule (blend_round1.json): adopt only if >= 8/10 paired repeats strictly better than exp117 AND repeat-0 ci_lo >= 0.4389 (published record). The adoption_gate_v2 quantities are still computed and reported, report-only.
adoption.then: critic pass in a fresh context before numbers_of_record.json changes; the critic may block for a bug but may not adopt a candidate that failed the rule in force. Only the orchestrator edits numbers_of_record / trackers (scripts/update_trackers.py).
